customerSymptomExample: My Archer C6 internet is buffering.
diagnosticQuestions: Are you using WiFi or LAN?
Is the issue happening on all devices?
solutionSteps: Restart the Archer C6 and wait 2 minutes.
Check the WAN cable and make sure it is firmly connected.
Place the router in an open area away from walls.
If many devices are connected, disconnect unused devices and test again.
riskAfterSolution: Speed may still vary if the upstream ISP link is unstable.
nextSolutionSteps: Update firmware only from the official model page.
whenToEscalate: Escalate if speed remains very low after cable and restart checks.
escalationMessage: Please contact your nearest Excel Customer Support Point.

solutionSteps: Check camera power adapter or PoE port.
Restart the DVR/NVR and wait until cameras reconnect.
Test the camera on another channel if available.
riskAfterSolution: Faulty cable or power adapter may require replacement.
nextPossibleProblem: Camera cable, power, or channel issue
nextSolutionSteps: Contact CSP if the camera remains offline.
whenToEscalate: Escalate if camera stays offline after cable and power checks.
escalationMessage: Please contact your nearest Excel Customer Support Point.
